title: E-Bikes Outsold EVs. Then EVs Caught Up.
source: US e-bike retail unit sales compiled from NPD Group point-of-sale tracking, vs. US electric-vehicle (battery-electric) sales compiled from Cox Automotive / Kelley Blue Book: e-bikes outsold EVs in 2019-2021 (roughly 450-880 thousand units vs 240-650 thousand), then EV sales overtook e-bikes around 2022 as EV volume accelerated past 1 million units.
